title: Subzeroditto's Double Jump
description: a simple double jump that all players can perform innately
body:
Adds a simple double jump that anyone can perform by pressing jump whilst in the air, when timed correctly negates fall damage, allows for more height, resets upon touching the ground.

Stuff for datapack creators:
This uses the saddle slot, if your datapack also uses the saddle slot, they will be incompatible.

Known errors :
Blast prot nullifies the effect.
